title: Backward intertwiners and a transitive commutant
summary: We give a negative answer to the hyperinvariant-subspace problem by constructing, on every infinite-dimensional separable complex Hilbert space, a nonzero bounded norm-quasinilpotent operator with no nonzero proper closed hyperinvariant subspace. Its commutant is a proper strongly closed unital transitive complex operator algebra.
family_title: Invariant projections, hyperinvariant subspaces, and transitive algebras

review.reason: Constructs a quasinilpotent operator without hyperinvariant subspaces, addressing a classical problem.
